title: Pure Dragonmaid
summary: Pure Dragonmaid mid-range strategy built on the battle-phase tag-out mechanic between humanoid maid forms and towering Dragon forms, supported by the 2025 support wave and generic staples. By searching Spells and Traps with Chamber Dragonmaid, transforming into high-Level Dragons at battle start, and fusing into Dragonmaid Sheou, the deck loops resources and maintains total board control.

summary.title: Starters
points: Chamber Dragonmaid on Normal or Special Summon searches any Dragonmaid Spell or Trap from Deck to hand (such as Dragonmaid Changeover or Hospitality).
Parlor Dragonmaid on Normal or Special Summon sends any Dragonmaid card from Deck to GY, setting up Changeover's recursion or revival targets.
Kitchen Dragonmaid on Normal or Special Summon adds a Dragonmaid monster from Deck to hand and discards 1 Dragonmaid monster.
Dragonmaid Hospitality Special Summons a Dragonmaid monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, then sends a Dragonmaid monster with the same Attribute but a different Level from Deck to GY.

summary.title: Opening: Chamber Dragonmaid + Dragonmaid Hospitality
steps: Normal Summon Chamber Dragonmaid and activate its effect to search Dragonmaid Changeover from your Deck.
Activate Dragonmaid Hospitality, Special Summoning a Dragonmaid from hand or GY and sending a matching-Attribute Dragonmaid to the GY.
Activate Dragonmaid Changeover, fusing Chamber Dragonmaid and a high-Level Dragonmaid monster from hand or field into Dragonmaid Sheou.
Activate Dragonmaid Changeover in the GY, targeting a Dragonmaid monster you control to return Changeover to hand and return the monster to hand.
During the Standby Phase, activate Dragonmaid Sheou to Special Summon a Level 9 or lower Dragonmaid from your hand or GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dragonmaid Sheou during the Standby Phase Special Summons a Level 9 or lower Dragonmaid monster from hand or GY; when the opponent activates a card or effect, Sheou negates the activation, destroys the card, and returns to the Extra Deck to Special Summon House Dragonmaid.
House Dragonmaid targets and destroys 1 monster the opponent controls whenever another face-up Dragon monster returns to your hand.

Lady's Dragonmaid is a Contact Fusion summoned by sending two Dragonmaid monsters with the same Attribute to the GY; it summons a small maid from the Deck and Fusion Summons a Dragonmaid in each Standby Phase.
Dragonmaid Lorpar discards itself from hand to target 1 face-up monster on the field and prevent it from activating its effects this turn.
Dragonmaid Tinkhec discards itself as a Quick Effect to boost a Dragonmaid monster by 2000 ATK until the end of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dragonmaid Changeover is the archetypal Fusion Spell that returns itself from the GY to the hand by bouncing a Dragonmaid monster you control.

Dragonmaid Tidying targets 1 Dragon monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls or in their GY and returns both to the hand; banishes itself from GY to Special Summon a Dragonmaid from hand or GY.
Dragonmaid Cehrmba discards itself to revive a Dragonmaid from the GY or banishment and protects your Dragon Fusion Monsters from opponent card effects.
Dragonmaid Downtime bounces a Dragonmaid monster to hand to search a Dragonmaid card or return an opponent's Spell/Trap to the hand.
